description: Utility provider's connection-approval record emitted by the infra-utility-connect provider_approval Pregel cell. One record per accepted serviceRequest; tracks the provider's grant of permission to install meters + connect service. Records the provider's response document (IPFS-pinned per G2) and any conditional pre-conditions the provider attached (e.g. site re-survey, security deposit, easement filing). Per ADR-2605250900 + gates G1 (open-source RPC), G2 (IPFS-pinned approval doc).

approvalId.description: Stable approval identifier (often the provider-issued connection number).

approvedAt.description: Timestamp the provider issued the approval document. Immutable.

approvalDocumentIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the provider-issued approval document.

conditionalPreConditions.description: Optional list of preconditions the provider attached. meter_install MUST NOT proceed until all preconditions are marked satisfiedAttestationCid.

expectedMeterInstallByDate.description: Optional provider-quoted deadline for meter installation.

providerRpcAttestationCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the RPC trace that retrieved this approval.

description.description: Free-text description of the precondition. PII filter applies.

satisfiedAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the evidence that this precondition has been satisfied. REQUIRED before meter_install can proceed.
